### User follow-up: hosted_tools and native provider formats

The user has now confirmed the retry reports `missing capabilities: hosted_tools`. The specific tool type and selected model are still unknown; this label alone does not establish that web search is requested or that an upstream cannot support it.

The user explicitly reiterated that a supplier may natively support some or all of Chat Completions, Messages and Responses. Evaluate each supplier, mapped model and native endpoint separately. Within the existing group/supplier/account order, prefer a compatible native endpoint; only consider a supported conversion when native forwarding cannot satisfy the request. Do not assume all suppliers are Chat-only, infer provider capability from a gateway adapter limitation, or apply cross-format loss restrictions to a working native path. Complete the capability matrix rather than asking the user to enable features one error at a time; no blanket hosted_tools enablement or silent tool removal. This incident remains unresolved pending that investigation.
